summary: National Grid plc filed a Form 6-K announcing that its subsidiary, National Grid Ventures, will invest $1.75 billion to acquire a 35% stake in Joulent LLC, a platform developing integrated power solutions for US large-load customers. The investment supports Joulent's foundational project, Project Kilby, a 2.67 GW co-located power facility in West Texas partnering with Chevron, supplying electricity to a Microsoft data center under a 20-year PPA. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the deal is a minority equity investment with no premium or price per share disclosed. The transaction targets first power in 2028; watch for regulatory approvals and execution milestones.
